notes: Keywords are matched case-insensitively as substrings; 'a|b' accepts either. Owners are compared by first name. Extra actions that match nothing are reported but only fail an item when they hit a forbidden pattern.

items.about: Every task has a stated owner; one idea is only floated.
items.transcript:
Attendees: Sara (SRE lead), Ben (Backend), Ines (Support)

Sara: Last night's outage lasted 40 minutes. Root cause was the expired TLS certificate on the payments gateway.

Ben: I'll set up automatic certificate renewal with cert-manager by Wednesday.

Sara: Good. We're also adding an alert 14 days before any certificate expires. That's decided, and I'll configure the alert today.

Ines: I'll send the customer apology email this afternoon.

Sara: We could also consider moving to a managed gateway someday, but that's a bigger discussion for another time.

items.about: One owner is implied, one task has no owner at all.
items.transcript:
Attendees: Noah (Marketing lead), Chloe (Content), Raj (Web)

Noah: The spring campaign launches March 3. We agreed the landing page goes live the week before.

Raj: The landing page is basically my area, it lives on the website.

Noah: Right. Somebody also needs to book the photographer, but we haven't decided who.

Chloe: I'll write the three blog posts, first drafts by Friday.

Noah: And the newsletter, let's figure out who sends it later.

items.about: Brainstorming only: ideas must not become decisions or tasks.
items.transcript:
Attendees: Elena (CTO), Marc (Platform), Yuki (Data)

Elena: Today is only brainstorming, we're not deciding anything.

Marc: One idea is migrating the monolith to Kubernetes.

Yuki: Another option is replacing the nightly batch jobs with streaming on Kafka.

Elena: Both interesting. Let's not commit to either yet. Yuki, could you write a one-page comparison of batch versus streaming costs before next Monday's meeting?

Yuki: Sure, will do.

Participants : Julie (cheffe de projet), Karim (dev mobile), Anne (QA)

Julie : On a décidé de reporter la sortie de l'appli au 15 avril.

Karim : Je corrige le bug de connexion sur Android d'ici jeudi.

Anne : Je préparerai le plan de tests de non-régression pour lundi.

Julie : Il faudra aussi prévenir le client du nouveau calendrier. Je m'en occupe demain.

items.about: A task is handed to someone else mid-meeting: the final owner counts.
items.transcript:
Attendees: Omar (Finance), Lea (Ops), Tim (Sales)

Omar: Tim, can you send the Q2 forecast to the board by the 10th?

Tim: Actually Lea has the latest numbers, she should send it.

Lea: Fine, I'll send the forecast by the 10th.

Omar: Thanks. We're freezing hiring until July, that's decided.

Tim: I'll update the sales deck with the new pricing next week.

items.about: Finished work must not come back as tasks.
items.transcript:
Attendees: Zoe, Paul

Zoe: Quick sync. Nothing new on my side, the database migration finished last week as planned.

Paul: Same here, the release went out Monday without issues.

Zoe: Great, then let's cancel Thursday's follow-up meeting, there's nothing to discuss.

Paul: Agreed.
